# Landscape support files

`desk/lib/docket.hoon`, `desk/sur/docket.hoon` and `desk/mar/docket-0.hoon` are unchanged Landscape 1.32.0 support files, copied from the independently maintained Urbit Connect desk. They parse and encode Landscape app metadata. Their existing source comments are retained.

The original pill export and matching MIT-licensed Urbit source are recorded in `docs/landscape-source-provenance.json`. The authentic upstream permission and copyright notice is preserved in `third_party/urbit/LICENSE.txt`, from [Urbit source commit d6ec15f](https://github.com/urbit/urbit/blob/d6ec15fbcb5675af6ac722e6f512f399a5fdbaef/LICENSE.txt), SHA-256 `b5d62c0a6f6b17ff490de29606527bf77b6509998ef07048488d659e2b719e52`.

The library and type files are byte-identical to that source tree. The mark differs only in trailing horizontal whitespace. Preserve this notice, the provenance record and the upstream license with any distribution.
